definitions.explanation: The act of changing one's residence or place of business.

examples.japanese: {来月|らいげつ}{引越|ひっこ}しをする{予定|よてい}です。
examples.english: I'm planning to move next month.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ}に{見積|みつ}もりを{頼|たの}んだ。
examples.english: I asked a moving company for an estimate.

examples.japanese: {引越|ひっこ}しの{準備|じゅんび}で{忙|いそが}しい。
examples.english: I'm busy preparing for the move.

notes:
Can be written as {引っ越し|ひっこし}, {引越し|ひっこし}, or {引越|ひっこし}.

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{引越|ひっこ}しをする (to move)
・{引越|ひっこ}し{業者|ぎょうしゃ} (moving company)
・{引越|ひっこ}し{祝|いわ}い (housewarming gift)
・{引越|ひっこ}し{先|さき} (new address, destination)
・{引越|ひっこ}しそば (soba given to neighbors when moving in)

CULTURAL NOTE:
Traditionally, Japanese people give {引越|ひっこ}しそば (moving soba noodles) to their new neighbors as a greeting. This custom comes from the pun on そば meaning both "noodles" and "nearby."

RELATED VERB:
・{引っ越|ひっこ}す / {引越|ひっこ}す (to move - verb form)
